evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Multireference electronic-structure calculations remain difficult to automate because critical workflow decisions, including active-space selection, state averaging, convergence recovery, and state identification, traditionally rely on expert judgment.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Benchmarking against 558 vertical transition energies (VTEs) from QUESTDB shows that an unguided baseline agent achieves 24.9% coverage with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.373 eV.
